function calcAspectScaled(width, height, maxW?): number

Defined in: core/utils/wasm/wasm-layout.ts:256

Height rescaled for a width capped at maxW, preserving aspect ratio: height·(maxW/width) — only shrinks; widths under maxW return height untouched. Rounded so CSS heights stay integer pixels.

Parameters

width

number

Intrinsic width.

height

number

Intrinsic height.

maxW?

number = COVER_DIMENSIONS.FHD_WIDTH

Width cap (defaults to FHD so 4K masters don't downscale mid-layout).

Returns

number

Rescaled height.
